scope: Add strict response and OpenAPI models to the tenant-scoped Data Stream attachment listing, including request-post binding.
Constrain CRISP evidence maturity to canonical levels 0 through 6 in the Gateway and Python/JavaScript REST SDKs.

focused_checks.coverage: Attachment scope and pagination, exact 17-field strict projection, OpenAPI schema, post binding, sensitive/invalid row rejection with sanitized no-store errors, CRISP bounds, and Python public SDK validation.
focused_checks.boundary: Mocked service/database responses and in-process Gateway only; no database or provider.

focused_checks.coverage: JavaScript public REST SDK validation accepts null/0/6 and rejects malformed or out-of-range CRISP maturity levels.
focused_checks.boundary: Mock fetch responses only; no network or provider.

result: Private Data Stream attachment reads now have an exact, no-store response contract that excludes storage URLs, Directus identifiers, and arbitrary metadata, and every row must match the requested post. CRISP maturity validation now matches the canonical database domain across Gateway and both REST SDKs.
limitations: No candidate or populated tenant database was accessed; source tests do not prove database RLS or populated-data parity.
Live OIDC/browser acceptance, tenant isolation, and signed attachment-byte delivery remain open.
No migration was required; rollback reverts the Gateway, SDK, tests, and generated OpenAPI artifacts.
